reviewNotes: Separate AI editorial review of all 38 original B1/B2 noun questions: checked full German sentences, articles and cases, every option, correct answer, bilingual hints and explanations, source provenance and distinct contexts. Deferred regional Eck due to unreliable source plural and objective. Corrected inherited usage claims for EC-Karte, Edelstahl, EDV, Durchsetzungskraft and Eigenverantwortung. Existing GM2 objectives inspected; no same assessable objective identified. Independent human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval pending.
